[RLOW.6.1.5] **`Date` arithmetic lowers to its own builtins.** A `Date` is held
as a day count and a `Duration` as nanoseconds ([RDSC.5.5.8]), so the integer
`+` and `-` would mix the two units. The compiler must lower `d + dur` to
`FN_DATE_ADD_DURATION(d, dur)`, `d - dur` to `FN_DATE_SUB_DURATION(d, dur)`, and
`a - b` with two `Date` operands to `FN_DATE_DIFF(a, b)`
(`proto/builtin_fn.proto#BuiltinFn`), and must not lower any of them to integer
arithmetic. The engine evaluates each as [LTIM.4.2.3] states.
